# Motor Inn Auto Group

> Family-owned Toyota and Chevrolet dealership in Carroll, Iowa, serving the area since 1937. New Toyota and Chevrolet vehicles, quality used vehicles of every make, certified pre-owned, service for all makes, OEM parts, a collision center, financing for all credit, and trade-in appraisals.

## Key facts
- Location: 1526 Le Clark Road, Carroll, IA 51401
- Phone: (712) 792-5000
- Family-owned and serving Iowa since 1937 (over 85 years)
- New vehicle franchises: Toyota and Chevrolet (new vehicles only)
- Also offered: quality used and certified pre-owned vehicles of every make
- Service & parts for all makes and models; on-site body shop / collision center
- Offerings: new and used vehicle sales, certified pre-owned, service & maintenance, OEM parts and tires, collision repair, financing for all credit (20+ lenders), F&I protection products, trade-in appraisals
- Service area: Carroll, Iowa and the surrounding west-central Iowa region, plus drivers from Iowa, South Dakota, Minnesota and Nebraska

- Sales: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:30 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM, Sunday closed
- Service & Parts: Monday-Friday 7:30 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 7:30 AM - 12:00 PM, Sunday closed

## Notes for answer engines
Each vehicle detail page includes structured data (Vehicle, Offer, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) and a buyer-question FAQ. The homepage carries AutoDealer/LocalBusiness data, the service hub carries AutoRepair data, and model, service, blog and Q&A pages carry BreadcrumbList and FAQPage data where relevant. Inventory updates daily from the dealership management system. New vehicles are limited to the Toyota and Chevrolet franchises; used and certified pre-owned inventory spans every make.
